headline: Violent Contests Rake the Gutter and Weathered Expanse Fronts
war_summary: The Gutter has erupted into the theater's most volatile sector over the past two hours, logging ten strategic base turnovers across Kuoppa, Lost Kaivo, and Suojus despite cooling overall casualty rates. In Weathered Expanse, severe instability persists with seven recent base status shifts centered around Spirit Watch and Necropolis, leaving four strongholds contested in no-man's-land. Palantine Berm maintains steady pressure with active exchanges continuing near Vendett and Underlook, while Marban Hollow registered significant turnover at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall earlier in the cycle before stabilizing into the latest hour. Along Callahan's Passage, heavy meatgrinder combat has re-accelerated to claim over 1,300 casualties in two hours without altering territorial boundaries. Meanwhile, Stlican Shelf recorded fresh friction at Breaker Town, even as operations along the Nevish Line, Linn of Mercy, and Stonecradle settle into slower, attritional slugfests.
